d: To lead Gulftainer’s Group-wide Artificial Intelligence (AI) strategy, development, and implementation, driving business transformation, operational excellence, and sustainable value creation through AI-enabled solutions.

The Head of AI will be responsible for identifying, prioritizing, and delivering AI opportunities across the Group’s ports, terminals, logistics, transportation, and corporate functions. The role will ensure AI initiatives are aligned with business priorities, integrated with existing technology platforms, and translated into measurable improvements in productivity, efficiency, decision-making, customer experience, and overall business performance. The position will also establish a responsible and scalable AI ecosystem, including governance, capabilities, technology partnerships, and organizational adoption, to support Gulftainer’s long term digital transformation ambitions.
r: Develop and execute the Group-wide AI strategy and roadmap, aligned with Gulftainer’s business objectives and technology transformation agenda.
Identify and prioritize high-impact AI opportunities across business units, operations, and corporate functions.
Translate business challenges into practical AI solutions with clear objectives, measurable outcomes, and business value.
Partner with executive leadership and business heads to embed AI into business strategies, operational processes, and decision-making.
Monitor emerging AI technologies, market developments, and industry applications to maintain Gulftainer’s competitiveness and innovation capabilities.
Lead the design, development, deployment, and continuous improvement of AI solutions across the Group.
Drive practical AI applications, including Generative AI, intelligent automation, predictive analytics, machine learning, and AI-powered decision support.
Identify opportunities to improve operational productivity, asset utilization, resource planning, maintenance, customer service, and administrative efficiency.
Oversee AI initiatives from concept and proof of concept through implementation, integration, and operational adoption.
Collaborate with IT, Digital Transformation, BPE, and business teams to integrate AI solutions with existing enterprise systems and digital platforms.
Ensure AI solutions are scalable, reliable, secure, and sustainable.
C. Operational Excellence & Business Value Creation
Drive AI-enabled operational improvements across ports, terminals, logistics, and transportation activities.
Identify opportunities to reduce manual processes, improve turnaround times, optimize resources, and strengthen operational performance.
Support commercial functions through AI-driven customer insights, forecasting, market intelligence, and business analytics.
Establish clear business cases, performance indicators, and return-on-investment measures for AI initiatives.
Track and report the financial and operational impact of AI implementation, ensuring tangible and sustainable business benefits.
Establish and maintain Group-wide AI governance frameworks, policies, standards, and responsible AI practices.
Ensure AI applications comply with applicable regulations, data privacy requirements, cybersecurity standards, and internal policies.
Develop appropriate controls for AI model accuracy, reliability, transparency, ethical use, and human oversight.
Work closely with IT, Cybersecurity, Legal, Risk, and Compliance teams to manage AI related risks.
Define governance processes for evaluating, approving, deploying, and monitoring AI solutions across the organization.
Work with the CTTO and technology leadership to define the AI technology architecture and infrastructure requirements.
Evaluate AI platforms, tools, vendors, and technology partners based on business needs, technical capabilities, security, and commercial value.
Oversee external AI solution providers and implementation partners, ensuring quality, cost effectiveness, and delivery performance.
Promote active use of enterprise data, system integration, and technology capabilities to support AI adoption.
Support strategic technology investment decisions and AI-related budget planning.
F. AI Adoption & Organizational Capability Development
Champion AI awareness, adoption, and responsible utilization across all levels of the organization.
Collaborate with HR, Learning & Development, and business leaders to develop AI literacy and capability-building programs.
Support business functions in redesigning workflows and operating processes to maximize the benefits of AI.
Establish AI champions and cross-functional collaboration to accelerate implementation and knowledge sharing.
Promote a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision making.
Establish and monitor KPIs to measure AI implementation progress, adoption, business impact, and return on investment.
Provide regular updates and recommendations to the CTTO and executive management on AI priorities, achievements, risks, and opportunities.
Ensure active coordination and accountability among technology teams, business owners, and implementation partners.
Manage AI initiatives within approved budgets, timelines, and quality standards.
Continuously evaluate the effectiveness of deployed AI solutions and identify opportunities for optimization and expansion.

d: Location: Etqan Global Academy (EGA), Doha, Qatar
Nord Anglia Education is looking to recruit a MYP Language & Literature Teacher (English) to join Etqan Global Academy (EGA) in Doha, Qatar.

Etqan Global Academy (EGA) is a newly established IB World School in Doha, Qatar, offering the IB Middle Years Programme (MYP). We are looking for a talented and passionate MYP Language & Literature Teacher to inspire our students to become confident, critical readers, writers and communicators within the IB MYP framework.
We seek an individual to join as MYP Business Teacher where your focus will be:
Planning and delivering high-quality, concept-driven Language & Literature lessons aligned with the IB MYP curriculum and global contexts
Designing engaging, inquiry-based learning experiences that develop reading, writing, critical thinking and communication skills
Assessing student work using MYP Business Studies criteria and providing meaningful, constructive feedback
Creating units of inquiry that explore language, literature, global contexts and intercultural perspectives
Embedding ATL skills and a genuine love of reading and language throughout all aspects of teaching
Supporting students' preparation for MYP eAssessment in Business Studies
Fulfilling Form Tutor responsibilities and contributing to the pastoral life of the school
Contributing positively to the English department and the wider EGA school community
A recognised teaching qualification (PGCE, QTS, B.Ed or equivalent) and a degree in English, Language & Literature or a related subject
Proven experience teaching Language & Literature or English in an IB MYP school
Strong knowledge of the MYP Language & Literature curriculum, assessment criteria and eAssessment
Excellent literacy skills and a genuine passion for language and literature
Ability to design and deliver concept-driven, inquiry-based and differentiated lessons
Effective classroom management and communication skills
A commitment to safeguarding and student wellbeing
IB MYP workshop training in Language & Literature desirable; international school experience desirable
x: Nord Anglia Education is the world’s leading international schools organisation. Our 80+ international schools are located in the Americas, Europe, China, Southeast Asia and the Middle East. Together, they educate more than 80,000 students from kindergarten through to the end of secondary education. We are driven by one unifying philosophy: we are ambitious for our students, our people and our family of schools.

Our exclusive collaborations with prestigious institutions such as UNICEF, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), IMG Academy and the world-leading performing arts school Juilliard mean we’re at the forefront of educational thinking, while creating life-changing experiences for students.

By joining Nord Anglia Education you will become part of a committed and innovative team. As a member of the world’s leading premium schools group you will be joining an active network of like-minded people across the world.
